description: The horizontal stacked bar chart illustrates the average rate at which two different models attend most to each input segment during generation. The vertical axis contains the model categories, labeled from top to bottom as "Ours" and "Standard". There is no explicit horizontal value axis with a line, ticks, or labels; instead, the values are represented as percentages directly within the stacked bar segments, which sum to 100% for each category. Each horizontal bar is stacked with three components representing the input segments, identified by a legend below the chart: "Context" in blue, "Generated Response" in orange, and "Other" in green. For the "Ours" category, the bar consists of a 60.6% blue segment, a 31.7% orange segment, and a 7.7% green segment. For the "Standard" category, the bar consists of a 23.6% blue segment, a 51.1% orange segment, and a 25.3% green segment. The bars are not sorted by total length as both represent a full 100% distribution, and there is no specific visual emphasis beyond the standard colors and data labels.
